title: A research story's plan says where its findings go: gap notes only or also article facts
goal: the sprint plan step of the kb-sprint skill has a research or gap story's goal state whether its findings go into dated ledger notes only or also into article facts with source rows, so no worker settles it with a provisional gate

run:
import re, sys
s = open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
i, j = s.find('## plan'), s.find('## start')
sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'(?i)notes only.{0,200}article facts|article facts.{0,200}notes only', s[i:j]) else 1)

gates.question: Where does the rule sit: the plan step of the skill and the matching Plan bullet in backlog.md, or the skill only?

notes: Retrospective of SP-5cyrnkw7 and SP-z6wolmvm (2026-10-22, operator accepted): six workers answered a provisional gate on notes-only or also-facts each by themselves (ST-a2cncqr3, ST-ho6xyk66, ST-polh634k, ST-qgojhpot, ST-rbf7q6ci, ST-xldi2ipx); the reviews overturned notes-only twice (ST-5p46sliz, ST-xfuucxk2).
